item.title: Polish Brainrot Meme 'Scooter Skir Skir' Makes Its Way To TikTokers At Large
item.description: Scooter Skir Skir is a series of brainrot memes based on a Polish AI video where the default Samsung caller ID character crashes a bicycle and then gets beaten with a belt by Daddy Pig from Peppa Pig. The video, generated with Grok AI, was purportedly originally posted by TikToker @poland.roads and deleted. In March 2026, the video went viral, inspiring other variations on the meme.

item.title: 'I Did That' Stickers Featuring President Trump Begin Popping Up On Gas Pumps Across The U.S.
item.description: "I Did That" Gas Station Stickers or Gas Station "I Did That!" Stickers, also known as Biden "I Did That" or Trump "I Did That," are stickers that have been applied to gas pumps next to the gas meter that often contain a certain political or humorous message. item.title: Scene Of Rodrick Recording The School Play Another Popular Meme From 2010's 'Diary Of A Wimpy Kid'
item.description: Rodrick Holding a Camera or the Rodrick Camera Meme is a reaction meme and series of image macros using a scene from Diary of a Wimpy Kid where Rodrick, from the perspective of his brother Greg playing a tree on-stage, is seen pointing and smiling at his video camera as he records the school play, suggesting he will use the footage for a nefarious purpose. item.title: The Internet Can’t Stop Using This Jonah Hill Reaction GIF -- Here’s Why
item.description: Jonah Hill 'Cut It Out' GIF refers to a reaction gif taken from footage of the 2012 Academy Awards broadcast. The GIF shows actor Jonah Hill doing a "cut it out" gesture, a downward side-swipe motion with an open palm. The GIF resurfaced in TikTok comment sections sometime around 2021.

item.title: The 'Scuba Dance' Has Been One Of TikTok's Most Popular Growing Dance Trends Since October 2025
item.description: The Scuba Dance is a dance created by Desean Hawk Logan-Russell (h5wk) where the dancer plugs their nose with one hand, extends their free arm forward and waves their hand back and forth while opening and closing their knees. The dance was created and posted on TikTok in early October 2025, going viral in November along with Desean Hawk Logan-Russell's song "Scuba Juke (It Stank)," which the dance is often set to.
